purpose: Seek reproducible independent evidence; do not equate Binance returns with LBank execution or user returns.
archives: First-party Binance USD-M BTCUSDT perpetual 1m/5m klines and fundingRate monthly archives, SHA256 checked
intraday_execution: First 1m open strictly after 5m close/publication assumption of 1s; actual 1m extrema, adverse same-minute conflict; censor gaps; original structural targets; no threshold fitting to final test

costs.funding: Actual archived settlements during holding; also stress fee/slippage at 2x

meta_model.selection: predicted net R > 0.10; opposite-direction simultaneous qualified signals abstain; highest prediction for same-side ties
meta_model.training: 2024 for 2025, then 2024+2025 for 2026; purge 1 calendar day before each split; no final-test tuning

published_direction_research.adaptation: EMA walk-forward long/short on 60m futures; not an exact paper reproduction
published_direction_research.selection: training net hourly Sharpe after costs; parameters recomputed only from preceding completed data
published_direction_research.role: Separate direction/holding model, not a TP1-entry alert and not comparable as an intraday target hit rate

lbank_promotion_requires: positive independent net expectancy with uncertainty assessment
execution and warning behavior on native LBank records
no venue substitution or hidden cost/risk-cap relaxation
